## ovhcloud support-tickets list

List your support tickets

```
ovhcloud support-tickets list [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --archived                Only archived tickets, or with =false only the ones that are not
      --category string         Only tickets in this category
      --exclude-autogenerated   Leave out the tickets OVHcloud opened by itself
      --filter stringArray      Filter results by any property using https://github.com/PaesslerAG/gval syntax
                                Examples:
                                  --filter 'state=="running"'
                                  --filter 'name=~"^my.*"'
                                  --filter 'nested.property.subproperty>10'
                                  --filter 'startDate>="2023-12-01"'
                                  --filter 'name=~"something" && nbField>10'
  -h, --help                    help for list
      --needs-reply             Only tickets waiting for your answer
      --product string          Only tickets about this product
      --service-name string     Only tickets about this service (for example a server name)
      --since string            Only tickets created on or after this date (RFC3339)
      --status string           Only tickets in this state
      --subject string          Only tickets whose subject matches
      --ticket-number string    The public ticket number, as opposed to the internal identifier
      --until string            Only tickets created on or before this date (RFC3339)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
  -d, --debug            Activate debug mode (will log all HTTP requests details)
  -e, --ignore-errors    Ignore errors in API calls when it is not fatal to the execution
  -o, --output string    Output format: json, yaml, interactive, or a custom format expression (using https://github.com/PaesslerAG/gval syntax)
                         Examples:
                           --output json
                           --output yaml
                           --output interactive
                           --output 'id' (to extract a single field)
                           --output 'nested.field.subfield' (to extract a nested field)
                           --output '[id, "name"]' (to extract multiple fields as an array)
                           --output '{"newKey": oldKey, "otherKey": nested.field}' (to extract and rename fields in an object)
                           --output 'name+","+type' (to extract and concatenate fields in a string)
                           --output '(nbFieldA + nbFieldB) * 10' (to compute values from numeric fields)
      --profile string   Use a specific profile from the configuration file
```
